verdict.rationale: Bun documents CLI commands an agent can run to install and update dependencies (`bun install`, `bun add`, `bun update`). Interactive selection is opt-in via `--interactive`, and `--frozen-lockfile` gives reproducible installs. The docs say only that an uncached dependency in offline mode 'is an error'; they never describe exit codes or a structured error contract, and community reports mention install crashes that need manual cleanup. Missing for 10: documented exit-code semantics, machine-readable error output, explicit non-interactive/CI mode guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent install and update project dependencies non-interactively, with clear exit codes and errors when something fails

citations.quote: `bun update` (alias `bun up`) updates every dependency, direct and transitive, to the newest version allowed by the ranges that request it.
Use the `--interactive` flag to choose which packages to update
For reproducible installs, use `--frozen-lockfile`. Bun installs the exact versions specified in the lockfile and does not update it.
a required dependency that is not cached is an error
